text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the dance studio, I caught sight of 
Mejiro Ardan and Mejiro Ryan finishing up 
their practice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san, are your legs holding up 
alright? Shall we just watch the reference 
video for the rest of the time and call it 
a day?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone~! Ardan-san, thanks so 
much for the other day~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this song! It's super tricky, isn't 
it~? Yaeno-san seemed to be struggling 
with it too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, even she is having trouble with it? 
And she is usually quite skilled at 
dancing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know♪ Since there are three of us 
here, why don't we try running through the 
center and side parts together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Practicing as a trio, huh? Sounds fun, 
but... Ardan-san, are your legs okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just once will be perfectly fine. I 
would love to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is a wonderful opportunity to dance 
with Chiyono O-san. And perhaps I could 
share a few pointers with Yaeno-san 
afterward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Alright, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's settled then! So, what should we do 
about positions?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Positions... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I... would like to take the center 
position. Would that be alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Ardan-san, you were 
way sharper than usual out there~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is because I dedicate the most 
time to practicing center choreographies.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I tend to push center 
practice to the back of my schedule...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When I think about how I might not even 
get to dance it... I hesitate. You're 
amazing... How can you be so dedicated...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—I simply wish to chase after the moment 
where I can shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if it turns out to be a radiance that 
occurs only once in a lifetime...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When that moment arrives, I refuse to let 
it slip away... That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Aiming for 1st place with that much 
resolve...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're right, though. If you're going to 
run, you have to go all out to win...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I... want to win too! Alright! I'm going 
to start practicing center right away!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...As expected of Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is the spirit, Chiyono O-san. I 
am sure Yaeno-san feels the exact same 
way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Those two... Chiyono O and Yaeno really 
are special to you, aren't they, 
Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Special...? Yes... They are precious 
rivals to me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey! If the day comes when you compete 
against Chiyono O and Yaeno, I'm 
definitely going to watch the race in 
person!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My, getting ahead of yourself already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I am certain it will be a race for 
the history books. Please do look forward 
to it...
